checkItem.title: Check items
checkItem.scopeHelp: A device: used for that device only. A device type: used for every device of that type
checkItem.deviceTypePlaceholder: Select or enter a device type
checkItem.limitsHelp: Enter at least one limit. A value below the lower limit or above the upper limit fails (the limits themselves pass)

checkRecord.title: Check records
checkRecord.selectDeviceFirst: Select a device first, then fill in each item
checkRecord.noItems: This device has no active check items. Add them under Check items first
checkRecord.mandatoryMissing: Mandatory item "{name}" has no result yet
checkRecord.abnormalPreview: {count} item(s) fail. The record will be abnormal and you can raise an andon
checkRecord.submittedAbnormal: Check submitted with failed items. You can raise an andon from the list
checkRecord.andonHelp: Reports an equipment andon at the device's workshop, line and station, listing the failed items. Each record can raise an andon once

maintenancePlan.title: Maintenance plans
maintenancePlan.leadDaysHelp: How many days before the due date the work order is generated; must be less than the cycle. 0 means on the due date
maintenancePlan.nextDueDateHelp: Leave empty when adding: last maintained date plus the cycle, or today if never maintained
maintenancePlan.generateConfirm: Generate work orders for active plans that are due? Each due date of a plan gets only one work order

maintenanceOrder.title: Maintenance orders
maintenanceOrder.completeHelp: The plan's last maintained date becomes today and its next due date today plus the cycle
maintenanceOrder.cancelHelp: Skips this cycle: the plan's next due date becomes this order's due date plus the cycle

oee.title: Overall equipment effectiveness (OEE)
oee.description: Availability, performance and quality by device or line, per day
oee.rangeTooLong: The date range can be at most 366 days
oee.selectTarget: Select a device or line, then query
oee.configHelp: Both can be left empty; the related metrics then show "Not configured". A device without planned time uses its line's setting
oee.cycleMinutesHelp: When empty, the standard time per unit of each report's operation is used
oee.outputNone: The device has no station or line, so there is no output source
oee.cycleFromRoute: the standard time per unit of each report's operation
oee.basisAvailability: Availability = (planned time − downtime) ÷ planned time. Downtime comes from andon events that recorded downtime (line-stop events or events with a downtime reason, from report to resolution); overlaps count once and periods crossing midnight are split by day
oee.basisPerformance: Performance = standard cycle time × output ÷ run time. Output is the reported quantity (good + defective, excluding cancelled reports). It can exceed 100% when the standard cycle time is too long
oee.basisOee: OEE = availability × performance × quality. Days with neither reports nor downtime are non-production days and are excluded from the summary; the summary adds up times and quantities of production days before dividing
oee.basisScope: Reports and andon events follow your data permissions (creating department and user). Missing planned time, cycle time or output source shows "Not configured"; a zero denominator shows "No data"
